comments.text: Mark u r the only one that has the steps correctly.  Garlic with the chicken and the meat.  The purpose that the Thais used garlic is to cover the odor of the raw flesh.  Also, you put the eggs last the eggs will cover the noodles which will add softness and moisture to it.  Well done.  Even Thai street vendors didn't do it correctly.  Some vdo even went as far as cooking the meat and the vege and set it aside.  Give me a break.. a tiny chinese restaurant has only a few minutes to toss this dish.. they will never do the steps like all vdos (so called chefs) did it on YT.
